text:
deploybot: kicking off deploy to prod: release v3.1.0 -> prod. Canary 5% for 10m. No DB schema migration. Feature flag `new-routing` ON. image: runtime-2.6. commit: abcdef123456. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Undo-Pathway-Runbook

maria: got it — i'll watch infra & app metrics. target p95 < 150ms, error rate < 0.5%. will call abort if thresholds breached.

liam: quick ask — can we pin runtime image in the deploy platform so rollback is deterministic? would rather avoid an image drift during aborts.

yun: yes. prepping undo artifacts now. i'll drop the rollback snippet here.

yun: ```
# rollback snippet (internal ops)
kubectl set image deploy/llm-api llm-api=release-2.0.9 --namespace=prod
./scripts/feature_flag_toggle.sh new-routing off --env prod
# pin image back to runtime-2.4 if needed via deployment UI or cli
```

ops-oncall: FYI — if anyone thinks a DB revert may be needed, emergency schema branch is at https://git.redwood.ai/ops/emergency-schemas. Not needed for this run but keeping it in thread.

sam: adding escalation thresholds for clarity: abort if any of the following: 1) p95 > 300ms for 3 consecutive 2m windows, OR 2) error rate > 1% sustained over 5m, OR 3) SLO alert for canary fires. Also abort on obvious functional regressions reported by QA.

deploybot: canary rolled to 5% -> steady. dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/rl/llm-prod-overview (internal). Alerts set to sam's thresholds.

ben: small ops note — when we pin during rollback, run `--pin-image runtime-2.6` on the deployment platform and scale replicas to previous count. I'll have the command ready in case.

julia: heads up — after switch, KV cache warmers need clearing to avoid stale prefixes. run `scripts/clear_kv_warmers.sh prod` post-rollback.

maria: plan for monitoring handoff: 0-10m i watch infra, liam you take 10-20, yun you take 20-30. if stable after 30m we go to 50%. call abort immediately if any threshold crosses. :thumbsup:

liam: acknowledged. i'll have the escalation bridge open and keep pager on. if abort, i'll call #eng-oncall and start the postmortem doc.

deploybot: canary 5% -> 10% at +12m -> metrics look fine. proceeding to 50% per schedule.

maria: increasing to 50% now. seeing slight tail bump but below sam thresholds. continuing to monitor.

yun: saved undo plan as internal gist (linked) and uploaded artifacts to bucket: s3://redwood-ops/undos/v3.1.0/abcd. gist: https://gist.github.com/yun/abcd1234 (internal).

ops-oncall: i've created a named undo path in the runbook: `undo-pathway-v3.1.0` and mapped steps 1-7. pinned runbook page for visibility.

sam: final reminder — if we abort, paste this minimal rollback checklist in thread and call it: 1) flip feature flag off 2) pin previous image 3) scale to previous replica count 4) clear KV warmers 5) restart worker pools 6) monitor for 15m 7) open incident and assign owner.

sam: minimal rollback commands to paste if aborting:
```
# abort (copy/paste)
./scripts/feature_flag_toggle.sh new-routing off --env prod
kubectl set image deploy/llm-api llm-api=release-2.0.9 --namespace=prod
# pin previous runtime via infra cli
infractl pin-image --service llm-api --image runtime-2.4
./scripts/clear_kv_warmers.sh prod
./scripts/restart_workers.sh prod --queue llm
# then monitor: p95, errors, request rate for 15m
```

deploybot: 50% steady at +35m. proceeding to full rollout per schedule. tagging thread with `undo-pathway-v3.1.0` for postdeploy reference.
